name: manual_aa3839
claim: The Biafra seats use Cline through launch_cline_wandb.py under the shared spend gate with verified boundary enforcement in orama-system PR #533 commit 3caa44b7: a stdlib loopback HTTP accounting proxy enforces synchronous socket admission in process_request, parses route paths without query strings, refuses non-allowlisted POST routes with HTTP 403, serializes /chat/completions under chat_gate to clamp forwarded max_tokens and max_completion_tokens against remaining budget, rejects post-breach retries with HTTP 429, parses model usage.completion_tokens (injecting stream_options: {"include_usage": true} for SSE streams), closes accept-to-dispatch races via stop_and_drain shutdown, funnels all transport errors (including HTTPError.read timeouts) through _fail_closed, and terminates fail-closed with exit code 124 (settling as unknown spend via _settle_unknown). BOUND_CONTRACT is true for both capabilities in orama-system, making the Biafra Cline route bounded-capable while missing or non-positive bounds refuse with invalid-launcher-bounds. Wanda keeps the direct OpenAI client outside the spend gate, is not authorized for unattended or paid use by that path, and her soul card forbids the Cline CLI.

decisions.notes: Supersedes lesson_67887871bd23.
